name: sport-flex
start:
if [ -f .cursor/start.sh ]; then
  exec bash .cursor/start.sh
fi
export SPORTFLEX_CHROME_NO_SANDBOX=1
if (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8765) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "sport-flex already listening on port 8765"
  exit 0
fi
exec .venv/bin/python -m sportflex ui --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765 --no-browser
